Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CITY OF BLOOMINGTON. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to workforce development; appropriating money for workforce development efforts in the city of Bloomington.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CITY OF BLOOMINGTON.

$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Bloomington for workforce development programming, including the Bloom in Bloomington youth summer internship program. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.
additions: $300,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the city of Bloomington for workforce development programming, including the Bloom in Bloomington youth summer internship program. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2028.
